title: athanasia incisa
intro: Athanasia incisa, commonly known as Mountain Sage or Red Hymenosporton, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The health benefits of Athanasia incisa include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help soothe sore throats and ease sinus pressure. The bioactive constituents of Athanasia incisa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections.
